tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i sgrub thabs kyi phrin las dbang chen dgyes pa'i gad rgyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// sa gsum zil gnon rdo rje rta yi glus// 'khor 'das bde ba chen por dbang sdud pa// gsung mchog pad+ma'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /yang gsang khros pa'i lha la spyi bos btud// gang de sgrub pa'i yig cha chu gter che// bsrubs skyes bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor blo dman gyi// gdung sel lhag bsam yar ngo'i dga' ston las// 'khrungs pa'i sngags shes ral pa mdzes pa'i rgyan// 'dir bka' gter gnyis 'dus pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i sgrub thabs nyams su len pa la/ rgyud nas bshad pa'i gnas mtshan nyid dang ldan par dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i sgrub pa pos/ dkyil 'khor gtor mchod sgrub pa'i yo byad rnams so so'i skabs dang 'tsham par 'du byas te/ sgrub thabs dngos la gsum/ sngon 'gro'i las khrigs/ dngos gzhi'i las khrigs/ mjug gi las khrigs so// dang po ni/ brgyud 'debs phyi gtor skyabs sems tshogs// bgegs bskrad mtshams bshags byin mchod brlab// ces brgyad du yod pa'i dang po ni/ chos sku gzi brjid rgyal po 'od dpag med// longs sku bde chen rab dgyes rta mchog dpal// sprul sku khams gsum zil gnon pad+ma dbang*// gsol ba 'debs so dbang dang dngos grub stsol// bde mchog gsang ba'i 'byung gnas mkhar chen bza'// sprul pa'i lo chen bai ro tsa na'i zhabs// mnga' bdag tshangs pa lha yi me tog la// gsol ba 'debs so dbang dang dngos grub stsol// rkyang po grags pa sum pa dbang tshul dang*// 'bre ban sher bla zhang ston gzi brjid 'bar// bla ma rgya dang grub chen 'dar 'phyar la// gsol ba 'debs so dbang dang dngos grub stsol// brtson 'grus rdo rje nyan chen bsod nams brtan// chos rgyal dpal bzang dpal ldan seng ge dang*// rin chen bkra shis yon tan mgon po la// gsol ba 'debs so=

chos dpal bzang po rdo rje rgyal ba'i mtshan// dkon mchog bzang po rat+na badz+ra dang*// dkon mchog dpal bzang phyag na rdo rje la// gsol ba= gu ru rin chen 'dar nag bde ba bzang*// kun mkhyen phrin las dbang chen bstan 'dzin dang*// ngag dbang phrin las ngag dbang 'jigs bral la// gsol ba= pad+ma bdud 'dul bstan pa'i nyi ma che// 'dar ston brgyud pa'i smin grol gdams zab bcud// kun 'dus 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po la// gsol ba= pad+ma rta mchog gar gyi dbang phyug ma// dbang chen rigs bzhi sgo srung khro mo bzhi// dam can chos srung bka' nyan bcas pa la// gsol ba= rnam dag dbang bzhi'i rim pas rgyud smin te// rim gnyis zab mo'i rtogs pa mtha' ru phyin// gnas skabs phrin las rnam bzhi rtsol med 'grub// mthar thug pad+ma he ru ka thob shog /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes snang ba rgyas// ma rig khams gsum srid pa'i mun khang bcom// 'bar ba thugs rje chen po dbang gi gar// 'khor 'das kun tu khyab par sgyur byed shog /e yig stong nyid dgyes pa mchog gi klong*// waṃ yig bde chen rdo rje zung 'jug pa// chags med pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor na// dpal gyi rta skad rab tu sgrog gyur cig / gnyis pa phyi gtor ni/ rgyas par spro na cha gsum gtor ma phyag len du mdzad kyang*/ bsdu na dkar gtor/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsang*/ swa bhā ba sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ sarba lo ka pā la bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa mgron 'gugs/ sarba lo ka pā la bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la// sngags spyod don du gtor ma 'di// 'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol//

zhes pa tsam mam/ spro na/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ sarba bhu ta gats+tsha/ zhes gtor ma phyi rol du 'bul lo// gsum pa skyabs sems ni/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bla ma dang dpal chen pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mkha' khyab kyi 'khor lor sad par gyur/ bdag gzhan nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro ba kun// deng bzung byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la skyabs su mchi// lan gsum/ sems can don du sangs rgyas thob par bya// de yi ched du rta mchog lam rim bsgom// 'gro kun bde ldan sdug bsngal kun dang bral// bde las mi nyams btang snyoms ngang gnas shog / lan gsum brjod/ bzhi pa tshogs gsag ni/ pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing*// phyi nang gsang ba'i kun bzang mchod sprin 'bul// thog med nas bsags sdig ltung ma lus bshags// dus gsum dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*// mgon rnams zab rgyas chos 'khor bskor bar bskul// bskal par mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs// dge tshogs ma lus sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol// lnga pa bgegs bskrad cing mtshams bcad pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la/ ru dra baṃ hrīḥs+pha ra ṇa phaṭaḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ skad cig gis bdag nyid pad+ma dbang chen dmar nag g.yas be con phyar zhing g.yon sdigs mdzub kyi rtse la me dpung 'bar ba/ dur khrod kyi chas rnams rdzogs shing dbu gtsug rta skad srid gsum khyab par 'tsher ba/ pad nyi ru dra bsnol ba'i gdan la bzhengs stabs su gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i khro bo'i tshogs 'jig rten gang bas bgegs thams cad tshar bcad par gyur/

hrīḥ dpal chen mi bzad dkyil 'khor nas// 'bar ba'i khro bo me dpung 'bar// gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams// bgegs dang log 'dren rdul du rlog /dbang chen me dpung dmar nag 'bar// bskal pa dus mtha'i me lta bu// dbang drag mtshon cha brag ltar gtams// gang la babs kyang gcod cing sgrol// dbang chen khro bo mi bzad rngam// srid pa'i 'khor lo ye shes 'khrigs// dbang chen mtshams las gang 'da' ba// rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bya'o// zhes dang*/ sum+bha ni 'i drag sngags kyis bskrad/ mtshams gcod srung 'khor ni/ hrīḥ steng 'og phyogs mtshams ma lus khro bo dang*// rdo rje ra ba bskal pa'i me 'bar bas// bar mtshams med par gtams pa'i gur khang ni// srung ba'i 'khor lo'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig /oṃ raṃ kro dha rak+ṣa badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ tīk+ṣa ṇa bi shwa dz+wa la raṃ phaṭa raṃ raṃ/ drug pa nyes ltung bshags pa ni/ rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis bla ma dang khrag 'thung dbang chen lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hrīḥ bdag gis dang po byang chub sems bskyed nas// sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin dbang phyug go 'phang du// yi dam lha dang rdo rje slob dpon la// 'da' bar mi bya bsrung bar dam bcas te// las ngan dbang gyur skye bo bdag 'dra ba// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang du gyur// sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags// yi dam lha yi phyag rgya ma gsal te// sngags dang bzlas brjod bsnyen pa'i grangs kyang chag /bsnyen sgrub bskang phyir dus kyi cho ga chag /nya shi dus drug mchod pa lo zlar 'das/ khas blangs dam bcas bzhin du ma bgyis te// gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags// snyan khungs brgyud nas thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du// lta spyod gsang ba'i man ngag gnyer gtad pa// spyod pa g.yel bas man ngag gnyer ma thub// nyams shing tshogs chag nyams pa'i tshogs dang 'dres// thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags// snang gsal sgron me rdo rje slob dpon dang*// dam tshig gzungs kyis 'brel ba'i yum rnams la// snying nas dmod cing thugs dang 'gal gyur pas// bka' chad gnas su gyur pa mthol lo bshags// dam tshig bsrung bas 'brel ba'i mched lcam la// rku brdung 'gran sems zhe sdang rdeg la sogs// ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal mi bzod par// ltung ba'i lu gu rgyud de'i rgyun thag chod// dbyings nyid nam mkha'i dbyings su bzod par gsol// bzod par gsol lo tshangs par bstsal du gsol// oṃ pad+ma shrī he ru ka sa ma ya/

ma nu pā la ya/ pad+ma he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ ḍ-i ḍho me bha wa/ su toṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shre yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān pad+ma shrī he ru ka mā me muñca pad+ma shrī he ru ko bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐/ zhes rigs kyi yig brgya ci nus bzlas la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dkyil 'khor pa rang la thim par gyur/ bdun pa byin dbab pa ni/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ zhi khro'i lha tshogs sngags kyi sgra dang bcas char bab pa ltar byon nas bdag gnas sgrub pa'i yo byad rnams la thim zhing byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ a la la hoḥ bha ga wān sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ 'phags mchog thugs rje'i dus la bab/ khyad par ston pa'i dus la bab// mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la bab// dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab// dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dus la bab// nyams chag skong ba'i dus la bab// mthu chen mthu stsol bcom ldan 'das// dbang chen dbang skur bcom ldan 'das// byin chen phob cig bcom ldan 'das// dngos grub mchog stsol bcom ldan 'das// bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag rnams la// las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ brgyad pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa la lnga/ dang po sbyang zhing spel ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las raṃ spros te ye shes kyi me 'bar bas mchod rdzas ma dag pa'i dri ma bsregs shing sbyangs/ a 'phros pa'i 'od kyis dpag tu med par spel zhing rgya cher rgyas par gyur/ gnyis pa phyi mchod byin brlab ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ las me rlung chu gsum byung*// phyi yi mchod pa'i dri ma bsregs gtor bkrus// a dhu pu ā ga na sha /sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ sa bon las grub mchod pa'i lha mo ni// chu dang nyer spyod rol mo legs thogs pa// dam tshig dbang gis byon zhing 'od zer 'phros// 'phags pa mchod cing sems can don kun byas// srid zhi'i 'dod pa'i yon tan tshogs kun bsdus// kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin phung 'phro// oṃ ā ha ra ā ha ra hūm̐/

oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ puṣ+pe nas shab+da hūm̐/ gsum pa bdud rtsi byin brlab ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bdud rtsi'i nyes skyon sbyangs// ma hā rat+na ka pā la bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe/ pad+ma/ sūr+ya/ rat+na/ tsan+d+ra/ e maṇ+ḍa la bh+rūm̐/ thod snod gzhal yas khang dbus 'khor lo ni// rtsibs bzhi'i lte bar pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad// rtsibs bzhir nyi ma rin chen zur brgyad dang*// zla ba rdo rje rgya gram rnams kyi steng*// dbus nas rim bzhin g.yas skor rak+ta dang*// dri chu sha chen dri chen klad pa rnams// āṃ pāṃ hūm̐ mūṃ swā māṃ ā+oṃ lāṃ dang// hā tāṃ zung du 'brel bas mtshan par gyur// sa ma ya s+t+waṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ sa bon bcu las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas// tshur 'dus 'od zhu yongs su gyur pa las// pad+ma rdo rje rin chen 'khor lo dang*// rgya gram dril bu lnga dang bcas par gyur// sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ de dag yongs gyur dbus dang g.yas skor du// mtha' yas mi bskyod rin 'byung rnam snang mdzad// don grub dmar mthing ser dkar ljang ba'i mdog /rang rtags phyag mtshan 'dzin cing yum dang 'khril// mkha' gsang rdo rje pad sbyor snyoms par zhugs// ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ phaṭa/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la e aṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ a nu rā ga ya mi/ a nu rā go3 haṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bde ba'i sgra dang byang sems 'od zer gyis// 'khor 'das snod bcud bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma bsdus// rigs lnga yab yum la thim 'od du zhu// bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho oṃ yig dkar pos mtshan// a ma paṃ hrīḥ sūr+ya tsan+d+ra pad+ma dha ra hrīḥ bdud rtsi'i steng du pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus// rta mgrin dmar nag pad+ma rgya gram 'dzin// phyogs bzhir srung ba'i mi pham khro gnyer can// ral gcig ro langs dkar ser dmar ljang mdog /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu 'dzin// bzhi ka'ang rgyab mdun zur nas yab dang sbyor// rta dbu'i steng du hrīḥyig dmar nag gsal// mtheb srin nyi zla'i ga 'us 'dzin par gyur//

g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar la/ oṃ sarba a mṛta hūm̐/ ci 'grub brjod/ hrīḥlas 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas mchod// rigs lnga'i rnam par byon te sbyor ba mdzad// byang sems rta mgrin zhal zhugs sgal tshigs brgyud// yum bzhi'i bha gar thig le dus gcig babs// yab yum lnga po bdud rtsir zhu nas 'dres// gang la 'thor bas nyes skyon bgegs sbyong zhing*// phan dang nus par ldan pa'i rang bzhin gyur// g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis gnas dang bdag grogs rdzas rnams la 'thor te/ oṃ swa bhā ba bi shud+dhe hūm̐/ dharma a mṛta hūm̐/ raṃ kro dha badz+ra rak+ṣa dz+wa la raṃ phaṭa/ raṃ raṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bzhi pa gtor ma byin rlabs ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis gtor ma'i dngos 'dzin sbyangs/ bh+rūm̐ pad+ma ba liṃ ta bi shwa tsakra bh+rūm̐/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la aḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la aṃ/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ gtor ma gzhal yas khang du gsal ba'i nang*// nyi steng hūm̐ las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas// tshur 'dus gtor ma chos nyid ngang du sbyangs// gtor ma'i steng du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad// a yig dmar pos mtshan pa'i 'od zer gyis// bdud rtsi ye shes lnga yi ngo bor 'bar// slar yang gtor steng zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus// oṃ yig dkar po'i 'od zer 'phro 'du las// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos rnams kyi// 'dod yon lha mo mkha' khyab sprin 'phror gyur// oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta pū dza te dzo hūm̐/ lan gsum/ lnga pa rak+ta byin gyis brlab pa ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis rak+ta'i nyes skyon sbyangs/ bh+rūm̐ ban dha ka pā la bh+rūm̐/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la/ ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ phyi dkar nang dmar thod pa'i gzhal yas dbus// ma las nyi steng thugs ka'i hrīḥyig las// ra 'phros 'od zer 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur// rak+ta'i rgya mtsho stong gsum khyon gang zhing*// rba rlabs rab 'khrugs zhing gi lhu dum 'phyo// tshil chen dar chags 'dod yon lha mo 'phro// phyi ltar khrag mtsho nang ni chos kyi dbyings// gsang ba yum gyi pad+ma rak+ta 'khyil// oṃ ma hā sarba rak+ta hūm̐/

lan gsum brjod do// gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i las khrigs ni/ dam tshig bskyed cing ye shes dgug /phyag 'tshal bzhugs gsol mchod cing bstod// dzap bzlas bcas te bdun yin no// de'i dang po la gsum gyi thog mar ting 'dzin rnam gsum bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐/ chos nyid nam mkha'i klong yangs nas// chos rnams sna tshogs rang shar ba// rang bzhin med de chu zla 'dra// thugs rje chen pos kun la khyab// snying po ye shes hūm̐ gi dbyibs// oṃ shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na sa mā ti hūm̐/ dharma dhā tu sa mā ti hūm̐/ dz+nyā na badz+ra sa mā ti hūm̐/ gnyis pa rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ rgyu yi hūm̐ las e yaṃ raṃ/ khaṃ suṃ keṃ dang bh+rūm̐ yig 'phros// chen po lnga yi snying po las// 'byung ba lnga yi dwangs ma chags// e ā ka sha maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐/ yaṃ bā ya be maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐/ raṃ dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐/ khaṃ rak+ta sa mu dra maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐/ suṃ pri thi wī maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐/ kiṃ ni ri ti maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐/ nam mkha' rlung me khrag mtsho dang*// sa dkyil keng rus ri rab ni// sa bon so sos mtshan par gyur// phyi ltar 'byung lnga nang ye shes// gsang ba yum lnga'i mkha' klong ngo*// bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe dz+nyā na tsakra maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐/ bh+rūm̐ las dbang chen gzhal yas khang*// dbus su gru gsum dmar nag 'bar// zla gam dmar po thod phreng dkar// 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi phyogs kyi mdog /mgo bo rlon pa'i phreng bas bskor// rtsig rmang phyogs skyong bcu yi steng*// rin chen thod pa lha brgyad kyi// phyi nang bar gyi rtsig pa byas// pha gu drwa phyed mda' yab bskor// 'dod snam mchod pa'i lha mo 'khrigs// rgyal chen bzhi dang thod skam gyi// ka ba thod rlon ka zhus brjid// klu brgyad gdung ma me tog phreng*// gza' skar bad dang dral phyam la// bdud rtsi rnam lnga'i zhal bas g.yogs// dbus lter byur bur mtho ba'i steng*// pad+mas bteg pa'i tsit+ta'i tog

/sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan// zhing gi rgyal mtshan lag pa'i 'phan// skra yi rnga yab mi mgo'i tog /dbang po'i me tog phreng bar spel// phyi rol pad ra dur khrod brgyad// rdo rje'i ra ba bskal me 'bar// ye shes 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi gnas chen po// 'khor lo dbang chen pho brang ldan// phyi nang med par yongs su gsal// de dbus gru gsum dmar nag steng*/ paṃ pad+ma baṃ/ a tsan+d+ra baṃ/ ma sūr+ya baṃ/ ru dra baṃ/ pad+ma zla ba nyi ma dang*// ru dra pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan// phyogs bzhi'i rtsibs dang sgo bzhi ru/ de ba baṃ/ ya ma baṃ/ nā ga baṃ/ yak+ṣa baṃ/ a tsan+d+ra baṃ/ dri za grul bum klu gnod sbyin// bsnol ma zla ba'i gdan rnams so// gsum pa brten pa lha bskyed pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rgyu'i hūm̐ yig babs pa de nyid hrīḥdamar nag dang maṃ sngon po zhig tu gyur/ hrīḥmaṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba rnams mchod/ sems can gyi sgrib pa sbyangs te pad+ma dbang chen gyi go 'phang la bkod/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ slar 'dus te hrīḥdang maṃ la thim/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ hrīḥmaṃ yongs su gyur pa las// bdag nyid pad+ma dbang chen sku /dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa// g.yas dkar g.yon ljang dbus dmar nag /spyan dgu smar smin dmar ser 'bar// dbu skra kham nag brdzes pa'i gseb// rta mgo ljang zhur phrum phrum ser// rngog ma le brgan rta skad 'tsher// pad+ma lcags kyu be con g.yas// thod khrag zhags pa ral gri g.yon// dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud// zhing lpags glang ko stag sham gsol// thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan// tshar gsum phreng ba'i do shal 'phyang*// rus pa rin chen sbrul gyis brgyan// thal raka zhag gi mtshan ma dang*/ khams gsum rnam rgyal rdo rje'i gshog /gar dgu'i nyams ldan brkyang bskum tshul// ye shes me dpung klong du gsal// oṃ ma hā kro dhī shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭa/

g.yon nas 'khril mdzad gsang ba'i yum// pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma// mthing nag ral pa mun ltar gtibs// g.yas pas snying thogs yab la 'khyud// g.yon pas dung dmar gtso la stob// dur khrod chas brgyan khro mo'i tshul// g.yon bskums bde ba chen por sbyor// yab yum gnyis kyi gnas gsum du// zla ba pad+ma nyi ma'i steng*// 'bru gsum rdo rje gsum byin brlabs// spyi bo'i gnas lngar yig 'bru lnga// yongs gyur ye shes lnga dbang rdzogs// hūm̐ badz+ra he ru ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ oṃ bud+dha he ru ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ swā rat+na he ru ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ āḥpad+ma he ru ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ hā karma he ru ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ rigs lnga khrag 'thung tshon gang ba// rang rtags dril 'dzin phyogs kyi mdog /thod pa'i gzhal yas khang du bzhugs// mkha' gsang hūm̐ dang paṃ yig las// rdo rje pad+ma mnyam par sbyor// bde ba'i sgras bskul phyogs bcu yi// sangs rgyas sras bcas spyan drangs te// yab kyi zhal zhugs thugs kar zhu// rdo rje'i lam nas yum mkhar bab// thig le yig 'bru brgyad du gyur// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ phyir 'phros so so'i gnas su 'khod// gdan bting sku bskyed dbang bskur zhing*// byin gyis brlab pa rab tu bya// yab yum gnyis med sbyor ba las// sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu gsal// oṃ badz+re shwa ra kro dhā hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rat+ne shwa ra kro dhā hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+me shwa ra kro dhā hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ karme shwa ra kro dhā hūm̐ phaṭa/ rtsibs bzhir gdon bzhi'i gdan steng du// shar du rdo rje dbang chen ni// dkar po rdo rje dbyug tho bsnams// lho ru rin chen dbang chen ni// sngon po rin chen lcags kyu bsnams// nub tu pad+ma dbang chen ni// dmar po pad+ma zhags pa bsnams// byang du las rab dbang chen ni// ljang gu ral gri rtse gsum bsnams// kun kyang khro gtum khros pa'i tshul// dbu skra gyen brdzes sbrul gyis bcings// dur khrod chas ldan me klong 'gying*// oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ

oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ lcags kyu dkar mo khrag ral can// zhags pa ser mo g.yu ral can// lcags sgrog dmar mo mthing ral can// dril bu ljang gu gser ral can// g.yas pa rang rtags phyag rgya bzhi// g.yon rnams snying thogs dur khrod chas// brkyang bskum gar gyis sgo bzhi srung*// ye shes rgyal po gtso dang 'khor// nyi ma dang ni 'od zer bzhin// bde chen thig le kun tu khyab// gnyis pa ye shes pa dgug pa ni/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ chos dbyings me ri 'bar ba'i dur khrod la sogs pa nas dpal pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bka' sdod phyag brnyan dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ hrīḥ chos kyi dbyings las skur bzhengs pa// dbang chen khros pa'i rgyal po bzhengs// dbus nyid ye shes gzhal yas nas// pad+ma rta mchog gshegs su gsol// mkha' dbyings yum gyi gzhal yas nas// yum chen khro mo gshegs su gsol// phyogs bzhi 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng nas// sprul pa'i khro bo gshegs su gsol// sgo bzhi gnas kyi gzhal yas nas// sgo ma bzhi rnams gshegs su gsol// dur khrod chen po'i gnas mchog nas// dbang chen bran g.yog gshegs su gsol// e h+ye hi bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi kā dṛ sh+ya hoḥ sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ gsum pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hrīḥ dpal chen khro bo mi bzad pa// rta mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ khro mo yum la phyag 'tshal lo// sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// sgo srung bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo// a ti pū hoḥ pra ti dza hoḥ bzhi pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hrīḥ dam tshig dbang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir// ye shes dbang chen dkyil 'khor mchog /pho brang dam tshig dkyil 'khor 'dir// dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba la bdun/

phyi nang gsang gsum sbyor dang sgrol// gtor ma 'dod yon mchod pa 'o// zhes pa'i dang po phyi mchod nyer spyod 'bul ba ni/ hrīḥ mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog dang*// bdug spos snang gsal zhugs tog sgra /zhal zas dri chab 'di rnams kyang*// pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la// mchod par 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pad+me shwa ra sa pa ri bā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ dhū pe puṣ+pe ā lo ke gen+dhe nai bid+yā shab+da pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya āḥhūm̐/ gnyis pa nang sman mchod 'bul ba ni/ mtheb srin sbyar bas nang mchod 'thor la/ hrīḥ rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag /rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman// rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos// ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas// rgyud lnga sems can kun sgrol ba'i// dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di// ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bcas la// bdag cag dad pas 'bul lags kyis// thugs rjes dgongs la bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// bla med 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol// oṃ sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi/ snga rabs 'das pa'i rdo rje slob dpon dang*// da ltar bzhugs pa'i rdo rje slob dpon dang*// slad nas 'byon pa'i rdo rje slob dpon la// rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rjes dgongs la dbang dang dngos grub stsol// oṃ sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi/ rgyal ba dgongs pa brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// rig 'dzin rig pa brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// gang zag snyan khungs brgyud pa'i bla ma la// rnam dag bdud rtsi= thugs rjes dgongs la= oṃ sarba pañca= bcom ldan pad+ma rta mchog he ru ka /yum chen khro mo gar gyi dbang phyug ma// rigs bzhi'i khro bo sgo ma bzhi rnams la// rnam dag bdud rtsi= thugs rjes dgongs la=

oṃ sarba pañca= ging lnga gza' gdong beg tse lcam sring dang*// gnas gsum dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// chos 'khor skyong ba'i srung ma thams cad la// rnam dag bdud rtsi= thugs rjes dgongs la= oṃ sarba pañca= sman gyi dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐/ ye shes khro rgyal dbang chen gyi// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub mchog /rnal 'byor lus ngag yid la thim// gnyis med gyur nas brtan par bya// rang gi gnas gsum du thig le byas la/ kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ wā ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ slar yang bdud rtsi gsang nan du 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ rnam dag rang byung grub sman 'di// pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la// mchod par 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// oṃ ma hā pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi/ gsum pa rak+ta'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ rak+ta dmar chen mchod pa 'di// pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la// mchod par 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ bzhi pa sbyor mchod ni/ hūm̐/ gsang ba thabs dang shes rab las// pad+ma nor bu mnyam sbyor nas// dgyes pa chen po'i bde chen ngang*// byang chub sems kyi mchod pa ni// pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la// mchod par 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// ma hā su kha bo dhi tsit+ta swā hā/ lnga pa bsgral mchod ni/ hūm̐/ sprul pa'i khro bo 'bar ba yis// zhing bcu ma lus thams cad dang*// 'khor ba nyon mongs rgya dral nas// dug lnga dbyings su bsgral bar bya'o// a mu ka mā ra ya phaṭa/ hūm̐/ zhing gyur thams cad rang bzhin bsgral// sha khrag srog dbugs mchod pa 'di// pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la// mchod par 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// ma hā māṃ sa/ ma hā rak+ta/ ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti/ ma hā pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi/ drug pa gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ khyad par 'dod yon mchod pa'i tshogs// sha khrag keng rus gtor ma 'dis/ khro rgyal rta mchog thugs dam bskang*// ma hā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi/

khyad par 'dod yon mchod pa'i mchog /sha khrag keṃ rus gtor ma 'dis// yum chen khro mo'i thugs dam bskang*// ma hā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ khyad par 'dod yon mchod pa'i mchog /sha khrag keṃ rus gtor ma 'dis/ khro rgyal bzhi yi thugs dam bskang*// ma hā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ khyad par 'dod yon mchod pa'i mchog /sha khrag keṃ rus gtor ma 'dis// sgo ma bzhi yi thugs dam bskang*// ma hā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ khyad par 'dod yon mchod pa'i mchog /sha khrag keṃ rus gtor ma 'dis// ging chen lnga yi thugs dam bskang*// ma hā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ khyad par 'dod yon mchod pa'i mchog /sha khrag keṃ rus gtor ma 'dis// gza' gdong lcam dral thugs dam bskang*// ma hā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ khyad par 'dod yon mchod pa'i mchog /sha khrag keṃ rus gtor ma 'dis// beg tse lcam dral thugs dam bskang*// ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ hūm̐/ sha khrag rus pa nang khrol mkhris// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*// nga rgyal phrag dog mchod par 'bul// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang*// phrin las dngos por bzhes su gsol// ma hā māṃ sa la khā hi/ ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ bdun pa 'dod yon gyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ gzugs kyi lha mo sku mdog dkar// phyag na mdzes sdug longs spyod bsnams// dbang chen lha yi spyan la 'bul// gzugs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod// sgra yi lha mo sku mdog sngo// phyag na sgra snyan longs spyod bsnams// dbang chen lha yi snyan la 'bul// sgra yi mchod pa bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod// dri yi lha mo sku mdog ser// phyag na dri yi longs spyod bsnams// dbang chen lha yi shangs la 'bul// dri yi mchod pa bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod// ro yi lha mo sku mdog dmar// phyag na ro yi longs spyod bsnams// dbang chen lha yi ljags la 'bul// ro yi mchod pa bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod// reg bya'i lha mo sku mdog ljang*// phyag na reg bya'i longs spyod bsnams// dbang chen lha yi sku la 'bul// reg bya'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod// chos kyi lha mo sku mdog mthing*// phyag na chos kyi po ti bsnams// dbang chen lha yi thugs la 'bul// chos kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod//

drug pa bstod pa'i sgo nas ye shes glu'i mchod pa ni/ rgyas par/ dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba sogs sbyar/ mdor bsdu na/ hrīḥ 'od gsal dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// zung 'jug bde chen rnam sprul pa// sna tshogs sprul pa'i skur ston pa'i// rta mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// spros pa kun las rnam grol kyang*// chags can chags pa 'dul ba'i phyir// bud med sgyu ma'i tshul 'dzin pa/ khro mo yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zag bcas phung po gnas gyur pa'i// nyon mongs rnam dag ye shes sku /phrin las rnam bzhi yongs rdzogs mdzad/ khro rgyal bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo// rtag chad bdag mtshan rnam dag cing*// bsdu dngos tshad med ngo bo nyid// dgug gzhug bcing dang dbang mdzad pa'i// sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo// gdug pa can rnams 'dul ba'i phyir// rab khros rngam zhing mi bzad pa// 'bar ba'i phreng ba rab 'khrigs pa'i// bka' sdod rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rten 'brel bcu gnyis rnam dag cing*// byang chub phyogs chos rang bzhin can// bde chen snying po legs rdzogs pa'i// gzhal med khang la phyag 'tshal lo// gnyis med ye shes rdo rje yi// sa gzhi ra ba bla bres gur// ye shes me dpung 'bar ba can// srung ba'i 'khor lor phyag 'tshal lo/ khyed la bstod pa'i dge ba des// lam gyi bar chad legs bsal nas// tshe 'dir tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs te// sku bzhi'i bdag nyid sangs rgyas shog /

bdun pa dzap bzla ba ni/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid khro rgyal rta mchog dpal// thugs kar pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi// ge sar la ni snying po hrīḥ /'dab ma brgyad la sngags kyis bskor// 'od 'phros bde gshegs rnams la thim// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bsdu// sems can sgo gsum dri ma sbyangs// rnal 'byor lus ngag yid la bsdu// zhes ting nge 'dzin la sems rtse gcig tu bzhag ste/ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa yab sngags nyid gtso bor bzla/ oṃ ma hā kro dhī shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum sngags te yab kyi phyed lhag tsam bzla/ oṃ badz+re shwa ra kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rat+ne shwa ra kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+me shwa ra kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ karme shwa ra kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ gu sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ 'khor sngags de'i sum cha tsam re bzla'o// skabs 'dir sgrub chen la sogs pa dang 'brel na dzap dbyangs rdo rje'i sgras bskul ba dang*/ mtshams rnams su rtags bstod gyer ba yin no// thun mthar dzap bstod bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ pad+ma rigs kyi khro rgyal mchog /dpal chen pad+ma he ru ka /mi bzad khro rgyal rta mchog dpal// dbang drag stobs chen rngam chen gtum// sku mdog dmar nag brjid cing 'gying*// dbu gsum rnam thar gsum yang ston// phyag drug rgyud drug rtsad nas gcod// zhabs bzhi 'khor ba'i chos bzhi sgrol// dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs// rta mgo ljang gu rta skad 'tsher// me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs// rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug stong sgrog /dregs pa pho mo dbang du sdud// dbang chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐/ khro rgyal rngam pa rta mchog dpal// dpal gyi sku gsung thugs mchog las// mchog gi dngos grub ye shes dbyig

/dus 'dir rnal 'byor bdag la stsol// oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta pad+me shwa ri ma hā kro dha ha ya grī wa ma ma rag mo dun tiṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ hūm̐ dzaḥ sngags bdun nam nyer gcig tsam dang*/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sid+dhi a la la hoḥ gsum pa rjes kyi las khrigs ni/ bka' srung gtor ma tshogs bcas 'bul// chad brtan rta bro gtang rag bshags// bsdu rim smon lam bkra shis bcu// zhes pa rnams kyi dang po bka' srung la gtor ma 'bul ba la gsum gyi/ thog mar ging lnga'i gtor 'bul ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis sbyang*/ bh+rūm̐ zhes gtor snod thod par gyur par mos/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta pū dza te dzo hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ rang mdun dur khrod kyi sa gzhi la g.yas su ra las dbang chen thugs kyi sprul pa srog bdag 'od kyi rgyal po/ 'od kyi mi bo che dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ral gri g.yon 'od kyi zhags pa thogs pa/ sku la seng ge'i slog pa gsol zhing*/ dbu la ji dar dkar po bcings pa/ nam mkha' 'ja'i ske rags can/ lcags kyi sder mo rnon pos dgra snying 'byin pa/ 'jigs su rung ba'i seng ge dkar po rngam sgra sgrog pa la 'chib pa/ shar du tsa las tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can dkar po g.yas zangs kyi gri ring dang*/ g.yon zhags pa dgra la 'debs pa/ sku la dar dkar gyi ral gu gsol zhing*/ dbu la dung gi cod pan bcings pa/ rta dkar po ngang ring la 'chib pa/ lhor tri las dam can rdo rje legs pa ser po g.yas gser gyi rdo rje dang*/ g.yon tsit+ta dmar po thogs pa/ za 'og sngo khra'i ber gsol zhing*/ dbu la bse men gyi 'gying thod bcings pa/ rta kham pa lag dkar la 'chib pa/ nub tu hri las bdud po ri nag spungs pa nag po g.yas bdud kyi khrom shing dang*/ g.yon zhags pa nag po 'debs pa/ sku la lcags kyi zhub khrab/ dbu la bdud zhwa nag po gsol ba/

bdud rta nag po la zhon pa/ byang du shu las srog bdag yam shud dmar po g.yas zangs kyi gri ring dang*/ g.yon zhags pa dmar po dgra la 'debs pa/ bse khrab dang bse rmog gsol ba/ bse'i ra skyes kham pa la 'chib pa/ lnga ka'ang rngam zhing khros la drag cing rtsub pa'i rnam pa can/ sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ pad+ma dbang gi zhing khams nas srog bdag 'od kyi rgyal po/ rgya yul nam mkha' chad chod nas tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can/ nub phyogs pha wang long bu'i mkhar nang nas dam can rdo rje legs pa/ bdud yul kha rag mgo dgu nas bdud po ri nag spungs pa/ btsan yul zangs thang dmar po nas btsan 'gong yam shud dmar po 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig thang cig yud tsam la e h+ye hi/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bdud rtsi 'thor/ rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya bstan la/ ra tsa tri hri shu sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ rdor thal phyes la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi rā tsa srog la hrīḥ a shug+me tri srog la dzaḥ tsa pa la a shug dzaḥ tri li dzaḥbadz+ra sā dhu hriḥ dun dun shu la grī wa i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu ya thai baṃ ya theṣ+ṭaṃ bhuñja tha dzi gh+ra tha pi pa tha ma ti kra ma tha ma ma sarba kā ra ta ya sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dhe sa hā yi kaṃ bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma dang*/ ra tsa tri hri shu ma hā sarba pañca a mṛta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi sa sman raka 'bul/ hūm̐/ dbang drag dkyil 'khor phyi yi bka' sdod ni// srog la dbang bsgyur ging chen lnga rnams kyang*// las su sangs rgyas bstan pa srung byed cing*// zas su dgra bo'i sha khrag tshogs rnams za// dam nyams dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod mdzad pa'i// dregs pa mthu rtsal can la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la// rmad byung rol pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol//

ces pas bstod cing phrin las bcol lo// gnyis pa gza' gdong gtor ma gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi mdun du rgya mtsho chen po rba klong 'khrugs pa'i dbus me dpung 'bar zhing sprin dang rlung nag bu yug 'tshubs pa/ thog dang ser ba drag tu 'bab cing 'brug dang glog dmar 'khyug pa'i sgra sgrog pa/ gnam sa cha lang brdebs pa lta bu'i klong dkyil du rā ma ra tsa sha rnams las 'od 'phros 'dus/ yongs su gyur pa las/ khro rgyal pad+ma he ru ka'i thugs kyi sprul pa gza' rgod drag po rā hu la/ sku mdog dud kha srin po khros pa lta bu mgo dgu pa/ phyag g.yas kyis skyin thang gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo nam mkhar 'phyar nas dgra bo'i yul du 'phen cing*/ phyag g.yon chu srin gyi zhags pas dam nyams 'ching zhing za ba/ lus po thams cad mig gis gang ba/ lto ba man chad dug sbrul nag po'i gzugs kyis rgya mtsho gting nas dkrugs pa/ de'i shar du zor srin dkar mo stag gi gdong can/ lhor bam srin ser mo dred kyi gdong can/ nub tu kong srin dmar mo ba lang gi gdong can/ byang du 'brog srin ljang gu chu srin gyi gdong can/ bzhi ka'ang srin mo khros pa'i rnam pa/ g.yas zor ba dang g.yon nad rkyal thogs pa/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyi 'khor gyis bskor ba/ skad cig nyid la dgra bo'i yul khams thal bar rlog par byed pa/ gtso 'khor de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis lho nub mtshams kyi srin yul laṅka pu ri'i grong khyer nas dregs pa gza' gdong lcam dral lha srin sde brgyad kyi 'khor dang bcas pa e h+ye hi badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rā hu la sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas dam la bzhag / oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi rā hu la ma ra tsa sha ya i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu

sogs sngags mjug sngar ltar sbyar ba lan gsum dang*/ rā hu la sa pa ri bā ra ma hā sarba pañca a mṛta la khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ sman raka phul/ hūm̐/ phyogs bzhi bar snang nam mkha'i klong yangs nas// dam can bka' sdod gza' gdong lcam dral yang*// las su sangs rgyas bstan pa srung mdzad cing*// zas su dgra bgegs lo thog snar ma gsol// dgra bgegs yul khams thal bar rlog byed pa'i// gza' gdong dregs pa can la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la// rmad byung rol pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol// gsum pa beg tse lcam sring gi gtor ma sngar bzhin byin brlab/ rang mdun dur khrod kyi sa gzhi la rta khrag dang mi khrag gi rgya mtsho dmar la dwangs pa/ rba klong gru gsum bsnol mar 'khrug pa'i dbus su zangs kyi ri gru bzhi pa'i steng du/ pad+ma nyi ma rta ro mi ro brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ praṃ dang zangs kyi ral gri las skyes pa'i gnod sbyin chen po sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i zangs kyi ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar bas dam nyams rnams kyi srog rtsa gcod cing*/ g.yon mda' gzhu dang dgra bgegs kyi glo snying thugs kar 'dzin pa'i mchan khung g.yon na bse yi ru mtshon dmar po bsnams pa/ zhal gdangs mche gtsigs ljags 'dril ba/ spyan gsum khro gnyer smar smin me ltar du 'bar zhing*/ dbu skra kham ser ltag par bcings pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku la zangs kyi beg tse dang*/ dar gyi ral gu dmar pos brgyan zhing*/ zhabs la sag l+h+wam dmar po gsol ba/ sgeg pa/ dpa' ba/ mi sdug pa'i gzugs can/ zhabs brkyang bskum stabs kyis me 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du maṃ las srid pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma/ sku mdog sngo nag /gdong pa bse/ so dung*/ smin ma g.yu/ me'i ral pa la mchong dang mu men gyis brgyan cing*/

gser gyi rna rgyan 'phyang ba/ gcer mo spyan dang zhal bgrad pa/ g.yas zangs kyi ral gri dgra la phyar ba/ g.yon lcags kyi phur pa bgegs la 'debs pa/ dred mo mi zan la zhon pa/ gtso bo'i g.yas su traṃ las las mkhan srog bdag dmar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas mdung dmar 'phyar zhing g.yon btsan gyi zhags pa dgra la 'debs pa/ bse khrab dang bse rmog gyon zhing ce spyang la zhon pa/ mtshan mo rgyu zhing dgra bgegs la 'o dod 'bod pa/ gtso 'khor gsum gyi mtha' skor phyogs mtshams brgyad du mi dmar gri thogs brgyad dang*/ shan pa nyi shu rtsa gcig po thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po g.yas zangs kyi ral gri 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon sha khrag nang rol la longs spyod pa/ thams cad kyang dgra bo'i srog len cing mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang ba lang gi ko ba rlon pa gyon pa/ gzhan yang btsan dmar stong*/ bdud dang srin po sum stong*/ ma mo 'bum/ the'u rang stong la sogs pa dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba'o// gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas byang shar ma ru tse'i dur khrod brag dmar po mchong lding gi pho brang nas gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig thang cig yud tsam la e h+ye hi/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ praṃ maṃ traṃ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgyas dam la bzhag / oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ rak+mo prāṇa āt+ma sa pa ri bā ra i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu sogs sngar bzhin sbyar ba lan gsum/ praṃ maṃ traṃ ma hā sarba pañca a mṛta khā hi ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ kyai/ byang shar mya ngam 'das pa'i zhing khams nas/ gnod sbyin beg tse lcam dral 'khor bcas kyang// las su sangs rgyas bstan pa srung byed cing*// zas su dgra bo'i sha khrag tshogs rnams za// dam nyams dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod mdzad pa'i// dregs pa mthu rtsal can la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la// rmad byung rol pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol//

ces bstod cing phrin las bcol/ spro na yi dam dang chos srung gi skong ba'ang bya'o// skabs 'dir bskul gyi rim pa rnams ni gtso bor mngon spyod kyi las dang 'brel ba yin pas de dag gi yig cha snga ma rnams su gsal bas ma smos so// gnyis pa tshogs kyi mchod pa la drug /byin rlabs spyan drangs spyi byer 'bul// rol cing lhag chog gtang ba 'o// dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi mdun phyogs stegs bur pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus su tshom bu dmar po bkod/ shar du tshogs zan/ lhor khur ba/ nub tu māṃ sa/ byang du dza gad/ mtshams kyi 'dab mar rigs mthun gyi tshogs rdzas bshams la chu chang nang mchod kyis sbyangs te/ oṃ raṃ kro dhā rak+ṣa badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ tīg na bi shwa dz+wa la raṃ phaṭa raṃ raṃ/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ tshogs rdzas ma dag pa'i dri ma bsregs gtor bkrus/ oṃ swa bhā ba sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ tshogs gzhong bh+rūm̐ las rin po che dang pad+ma'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ tshogs rdzas oṃ āḥhūm̐ las ye shes rdo rje'i bdud rtsi 'dod yon rnam lnga'i phung po phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin bde chen lha mo'i rol pa dang bcas pa/ 'dod rgu rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba'i rin po che'i gter rnam par dag par gyur/ oṃ ma hā rat+na ka mā la bi shud+dhe hūm̐/ lan gsum/ gnyis pa spyan drang ba ni/ hūm̐/ rang bzhin rnam dag dbyings nyid las// sprul pa'i khro bo mi bzad pa// pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor lha// longs spyod tshogs la gshegs su gsol// oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga bān ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ma hā pad+me shwa ra sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ gsum pa spyir 'bul ba ni/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di// ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te// dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes su gsol// ma hā pad+me shwa ra sa pa ri bā ra i daṃ dhū paṃ puṣ+paṃ dī paṃ gan+dhaṃ nai bid+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/

hūm̐/ 'di na sna tshogs gzugs mchis te// gzugs kyi lha mo me long ma// me long las kyang gzugs rnams 'byung*// mang po bsam gyis mi khyab pas// phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams bkang ste// dkyil 'khor lha yi spyan la 'bul// gzugs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod// 'di na sna tshogs sgra mchis te// sgra yi lha mo pi waṃ ma// pi waṃ las kyang sgra rnams 'byung*// mang po bsam gyis mi khyab pas// phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams bkang ste// dkyil 'khor lha yi snyan la 'bul// sgra yi mchod pa bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod// 'di na sna tshogs dri mchis te// dri yi lha mo spos khang ma// spos khang las kyang dri rnams 'byung*// mang po bsam gyis mi khyab pas// phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams bkang ste// dkyil 'khor lha yi shangs la 'bul// dri yi mchod pa bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod// 'di na sna tshogs ro mchis te// ro yi lha mo zhal zas ma// zhal zas las kyang ro rnams byung*// mang po bsam gyis mi khyab pas// phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams bkang ste// dkyil 'khor lha yi ljags la 'bul// ro yi mchod pa bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod// 'di na sna tshogs reg mchis te// reg gi lha mo na bza' ma// na bza' las kyang reg rnams 'byung*// mang po bsam gyis mi khyab pas// phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams bkang ste// dkyil 'khor lha yi sku la 'bul// reg gi mchod pa bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod// 'di na sna tshogs chos mchis te// chos kyi lha mo po ti ma// po ti las kyang chos rnams 'byung*// mang po bsam gyis mi khyab pas// phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams bkang nas// dkyil 'khor lha yi thugs la 'bul// chos kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod//

bzhi pa bye brag tu 'bul ba ni/ tshogs phud cha gsum du bgos te rim par phul ba'i dang po bstod de 'bul ba ni/ hrīḥ sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung ba dang*// dgod dang gshe dang 'jigs par byed pa dang*// snying rje rngams dang zhi ba la sogs pa// sku yi dngos po shin tu bsgyur ba ni// gar gcas sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa// gar gyi dbang phyug gtso bo che// zla ba la sogs snying po can// māṃ sa la sogs ro mchog gsol// me tog la sogs tsan+dan dri// bzang dgu 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// mi mo rnams kyi reg bya mchog /byin gyis rlobs shig rnal 'byor pa// sgrub pa'i rdzas 'di thams cad la// hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyis ldan par mdzod// ma hā pad+me shwa ra sa pa ri bā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha raṃ khā hi/ bar pa bshags te 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs su gsol// bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis// bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur te// pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi// thugs dang 'gal ba'i las rnams ci bgyis pa// thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol// bzod par gsol te tshangs par bstsal du gsol// tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// oṃ pad+ma shrī he ru ka sogs yig brgya lan gsum bzla/ mtha' ma bstab ste 'bul ba ni/ mngon spyod kyi las dang 'brel ba'i skabs bsgral thabs gsum gyis rnam rtog chos nyid du bsgral ba'i bye brag /phyi ltar liṅga dgra bgegs su bsgral ba gsum/ tha ma 'tshengs pa gsum dang ldan pa'i gyer sgom rgyas par spro dgos kyang*/ 'dir tshogs mchod dkyus ma'i dbang du byas nas tshogs tha ma la dmigs te/ e raṃ/ phaṭa raṃ/ dz+wa la raṃ/ nṛ dzaḥ tri dzaḥ na mo dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang*/ chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/

rig 'dzin zhi khro sgyu 'phrul rnam par rol pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi= sprul pa yang sprul phyag brnyan dang bcas pa rnams kyi= bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis ma rungs pa'i sems can bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa thams cad mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la mchis par gyur cig /nṛ yaṃ dzaḥnṛ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ tri yaṃ dzaḥtri badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ zhes lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas bkug la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐/ sprul pa'i khro bo 'bar ba yis// zhing bcu ma lus thams cad dang*// 'khor ba'i nyon mongs rgya phral nas// dug lnga dbyings su bsgral bar bya// sarba sha trūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa/ hūm̐/ zhing gyur thams cad rang bzhin bsgral// sha khrag srog dbugs mchod pa 'di// pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la// mchod par 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// oṃ ma hā māṃ sa la khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti khā hi/ ma hā pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes bstab bo// 'dir 'og tu dgos pa'i gtsang lhag zur du bzhag go /lnga pa tshogs la rol zhing smon lam gdab pa ni/ bza' btung rnams brda dang brda'i 'bul len gyis brims te/ nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul du longs spyad la/ hoḥ bdag cag rdo rje slob dpon mched dang lcam dral rnams kyis/ ma hā māṃ sa gsol ba la brten nas rdo rje sems dpa'i sku tshe dang lang tsho la mnga' brnyes par gyur cig /dza gad dpa' bo gsol ba la brten nas 'gro ba mang po dbang du 'dus par gyur cig /zhal zas kyi bye brag mang po gsol ba la brten nas dpal chen po pad+ma dbang chen gyi rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mnga' brnyes par gyur cig / ces brjod/ drug pa lhag ma'i cho ga la gnyis/ yar gnas dang mar gnas so// dang po ni/ sngar bcad pa'i lhag phud dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du bzhag la/ yar gyi gnas gsal gdab pa ni/

bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe dz+nyā na tsakra maṇ+ḍa la bh+rūm̐/ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kro dhī shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+re shwa ra kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rat+ne shwa ra kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+me shwa ra kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ karme shwa ra kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ pad+ma dbang chen khrag 'thung lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa gsal bar gyur/ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha sogs gtso 'khor gyi sngags rnams slar yang lan gcig brjod pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ oṃ ma hā pad+me shwa ra sa pa ri bā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ yar gyi gnas rnams kyi zhal du ma hā pañca a mṛta khā hi/ ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ hrīḥ dmar nag gru gsum dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas// bcom ldan dpal chen pad+ma he ru ka /'khor du dregs pa'i tshogs rnams 'bum gyis bskor// dbang chen rngam pa'i gnas nas sku bzhengs la// dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la// thun mong mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlogs// rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// dbyings nyid rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// yum chen pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma// 'khor du ma mo chen mo 'bum gyis bskor// ma tshogs gnas nas 'khor bcas sku bzhengs la// dam rdzas rgyan gyi= thun mong mchog gi= gnod pa'i dgra bgegs= rnal 'byor bcol pa'i= phyogs bzhi'i 'khor lor gdon bzhi'i gdan steng du// sprul pa'i khro rgyal dbang chen rigs bzhi yang*// 'khor du dri za la sogs 'bum gyis bskor// rang rang gnas nas 'khor bcas sku bzhengs la// dam rdzas= thun mong = gnod pa'i= rnal 'byor= zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i dkyil 'khor nas// sgo ma lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril// 'khor du dkar ser dmar ljang 'bum gyis bskor// phyogs bzhi'i sgo khyud gnas nas sku bzhengs la// dam rdzas=

thun mong = gnod pa'i= rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// gnyis pa mar gnas bsngo ba la/ mgron sdud pa ni/ dpal chen po'i pham phab la dbang ba'i lha tshogs e h+ye hi dzaḥdzaḥ mthe bong gnyis bsnol sor mo rnams nang du gdengs pa gdengs ka'i phyag rgya byas la/ mu dra sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes dbang du sdud/ yang gong gi phyag rgya las sor mo rnams phyir gdengs te/ mu dra sa ma ya phaṭa/ ces zil gyis mnan/ rnal 'byor pa'i tshogs lhag slob dpon gyi mdun du bzhag la byin gyis brlab pa ni/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la/ āḥpāṃ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ rang gi ya rkan nyi ma'i steng du 'od dpag med/ ma rkan zla ba'i steng du gos dkar mo yab yum gyi skur gsal bar gyur/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ phaṭa/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la e aṃ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ a nu rā ga ya hoḥ a nu rā ga yā mi dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ yab yum rjes chags kyis snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun lan gsum du babs pas snod pad+ma bhañja/ bcud zag med kyi bdud rtsi/ gnyis ka'ang so so'i yid dang mthun pa'i 'dod rgu'i longs spyod rnam par dag par gyur/ bdud rtsi'i kha phru lan gsum btab la/ bo dhi tsit+ta s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ gsum brjod/ de nyid dkyil 'khor las dma' ba'i stegs bur bkod pa'i steng du sngar gyi lhag phud bkod la yar gnas bsre ba sogs dkyus kyi phyag len ltar byas la/ hūm̐/ dang po phud kyis mi mchod du// bcom ldan dpal chen phud kyi bdag /bar du tshogs la mi rol du// ma dang sring mo tshogs la dgyes// tha ma lhag ma mi bya ru// dbang chen bran g.yog lhag la dbang*// lhag ma kha chus mi bran du// rje dang 'bangs gnyis khyad par che// rnam gsum gcig tu mi bsre ru// chos kyi dbyings la bzang ngan med// mchod nas las la mi 'chol du// chos 'khor bstan pa bshig pa byung*// hrīḥ

dmar nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas// bcom ldan pad+ma he ru ka /yum chen pad+ma gar dbang la// bde gshegs khyung gis bskor ba ni// bud+dha rigs kyi khyung chen dang*// rdo rje rigs kyi khyung chen dang*// rin chen rigs kyi khyung chen dang*// pad+ma rigs kyi khyung chen dang*// las kyi rigs kyi khyung chen dang*// rang rang 'khor dang bcas pa la// rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul gyis// bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// dpag bsam rtse nas bzhengs pa yi// las kyi khyung chen pho mo la// rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul gyis// bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// bud+dha ga ru ḍa/ badz+ra ga ru ḍa/ rat+na ga ru ḍa/ pad+ma ga ru ḍa/ karma ga ru ḍa/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ pū dza hoḥ rak+ta pi pa swā hā/ hrīḥ dmar nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas// bcom ldan pad+ma he ru ka /yum chen pad+ma gar dbang la// srin po pho mos bskor ba ni// phyogs bzhi nam mkha'i klong yangs nas// gza' mchog chen po rā hu la// ngan sngags bdag mo gdong mo bzhi// shar gyi zor srin stag gi gdong*// lho yi bam srin dred mo'i gdong*// nub kyi kong srin ba glang gdong*// byang gi 'brog srin chu srin gdong*// ngan sngags bdag mo khyed bzhi yang*// gtor ma len pa'i len tshul ni// nam mkha'i dkyil nas 'brug ldir ba// bar snang khams nas glog 'khyug pa// sad dang thog dang ser 'beb ma// sprin dang rlung 'tshubs nang shed na// 'ur 'ur thog thog 'jigs byed ma// rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul gyis// bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// rā hu la badz+ra rak+ṣa ma ra tsa sha dha ya i dam ba liṃ gṛh+na kha kha khā hi khā hi pū dza hoḥ rak+ta pi pa swā hā/ hrīḥ dmar nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas// bcom ldan pad+ma he ru ka /yum chen pad+ma gar dbang la// ma mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba ni// ma tshogs rang byung gzhal yas nas// stong gsum phung byed ma mo ni// nag ser dmar ljang ral pa can// phyag na sbrul gyi zhags pa bsnams// sbrul dang thod phreng rgyan du byas// rma bya'i thul pa sku la gsol// gtor ma len pa'i len tshul ni/

kha nas bshug pa'i sgra 'bod cing*// lag na thod pa'i rnga chen brdung*// ma tshogs 'bum sde dam la sdud// rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul gyis// bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ma mo rak+mo ma hā kā li i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa pū dza hoḥ rak+ta pi pa swā hā/ hrīḥ dmar nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas// bcom ldan pad+ma he ru ka /yum chen pad+ma gar dbang la// dregs pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba ni// bdud btsan rgyal po la sogs pa// sde brgyad lha srin thams cad kyang*// gtor ma len pa'i len tshul ni// stong gsum thams cad khu sgras 'debs// sha khrag za zhing dgra la chas// mtshon cha dgra la ston cing rngams// rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul gyis// bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// rā dza srog la hrīḥ a shug+me tri srog la dzaḥ tsa pa la a shug dzaḥ tri li dzaḥbadz+ra sā dhu trīḥ dun dun shu la grī ba/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi pū dza hoḥ rak+ta pi pa swā hā/ ya hi gats+tsha/ zhes lhag ma phyi rol du dor zhing mgron gshegs so/ tshogs zlog byed na tshogs lhag dmar gtor dang lhan cig bshams la// mjug tu sgo dbye gser skyems zor bskul rnams byed cing gnod pa'i phyogs su gtong ba ste tshogs mchod dkyus su mi dgos pas 'dir ma spros so// de dag gis tshogs mchod bstan zin to// gsum pa chad mdo ni/ hrīḥ sngon tshe rngam pa 'bar ba'i gnas mchog tu// bcom ldan pad+ma khrag 'thung he ru kas/ khyad par bstan pa zhes bya'i ting 'dzin gyis// dregs pa dbang du bsdus nas rgyud gsungs tshe// bka' sdod srung mar bcas pa'i tshogs rnams kyis// sgrub pa po yi sdongs grogs byed do zhes/ khas blangs dam bcas ji bzhin deng gi dus// gtor ma 'di longs bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod// bar du slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*// gter ston rnam gsum grub thob 'dar 'phyar gyis/

khrag 'thung lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas// sngon gyi dam tshig gnyan po bsgrags pa'i tshe// bka' sdod srung mar bcas pa'i tshogs rnams kyis// sgrub pa po yi sdongs grogs byed do zhes/ khas blangs dam bcas ji bzhin deng gi dus// gtor ma 'di longs bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod// da lta bkra shis byin chags gnas mchog 'dir// rdo rje slob dpon mched dang lcam dral gyis// bsnyen sgrub las sbyor bzhi ste/ bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor zhing gi rdul snyed dang bcas pa/ dpal chen po'i pham phab dang sgrub pa po'i sdongs grogs la 'dir gshegs shig /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ e ā ral+li hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ phyag rgya gong bzhin byas la/ mu dra sa ma ya phaṭa/ bh+yoḥ bka' yi tshogs dang bcas pa nyid/ khrag 'thung de bzhin nam mkha'i sku /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs skyong ma rnams// 'dir gshegs dam skongs phrin las mdzod// bdag nyid chen mo la sogs bdud mo bzhi// gangs dkar sha med la sogs gnod sbyin bzhi// kong btsun de mo la sogs sman btsun bzhi// brtan ma chen mo khyed rnams kyang*// sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la// bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas// lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang bcas// sil snyan mang po'i sgra dang bcas// 'dir gshegs dam skongs phrin las mdzod// slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng dang*// bshes gnyen lang ka dpal brtsegs kyis// rgya yul de ni brtan bzang du// zhing chen 'khrigs pa'i gdan steng du// rnam lnga zhing gi mchod bkram ste// lag tu rdo rje e raṃ/ phaṭa raṃ/ dz+wa la raṃ/ nṛ dzaḥtri dzaḥ pra be sha ya phaṭa/ ā be sha ya āḥ hrīḥ dmar nag gru gsum 'khyil pa yi// dbang chen dkyil 'khor chen po nas// bcom ldan pad+ma he ru ka /dbang chen rngam pa'i sgra sgrog cing*// dbang gi rta skad tse re re/ khro bo'i 'brug sgra 'u ru ru// rol pa'i rta bro chems se chem// gsang ba'i bshug glu kyu ru ru// bskal pa'i glog dmar ljibs se ljib// rdo rje'i thog 'beb lams se lam// hūm̐ gis khams gsum dbang du sdud// phaṭa kyis dregs pa'i bdud dpung sreg /rngam chen sku yi dkyil 'khor nas// dbang chen rus pa'i phung po la// gsod byed byams pa'i bro brdungs pas// zhe sdang me yi tshogs chen bcom/ khrag 'thung gsung gi dkyil 'khor nas// sreg byed rak+ta'i chu bo la// rdung byed dbang pos bro brdungs pas// 'dod chags rgya mtsho'i rba klong bcom// dpal chen thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas// ma rig sha yi phung po la// kun mkhyen gsal ba'i bro brdungs pas// gti mug mun pa'i tshogs chen bcom// gtum chen yon tan dkyil 'khor nas// ngar 'dzin dregs pa'i phung po la// bdag med rdo rje'i bro brdungs pas// nga rgyal brag ri'i tshogs chen bcom// 'jigs byed phrin las dkyil 'khor nas// 'gro rgyud ser chen 'khyil ba la// 'dod chen snying rje'i bro brdungs pas// phrag dog 'dod pa'i tshogs chen bcom// ma chags pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor nas// rnam rtog bgegs kyi phung po la// gnyis med rol pa'i bro brdungs pas// gnyis 'dzin gdon gyi tshogs chen bcom// nyon mongs rdul du rlog pa'i bro// nyon mongs steng du da rdungs shig /rnam rtog phye ru 'thag pa'i bro// rtog pa'i mgo la da rdungs shig /skye med klong du chems se chem// 'gag med klong du khrigs se khrig /dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya nan// dgra bgegs thams cad s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/

dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ rdul tshon la ye shes pa gshegs/ a kā ro sa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba sogs spyi bzhin bya/ bdag bskyed la dmigs te/ oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ snod bcud gzhal yas de yang 'khor la thim// 'khor rnams gtso bo yum yang yab la thim// dbang chen sku yang 'ja' tshon ltar yal nas// ka dag gdod ma'i klong du badz+ra muḥ zhes gnas lugs kyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag la rtag mtha' bsal/ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ slar yang chu las chu bur brdol ba ltar// rang nyid yang gsang khros par gsal ba yi// sku las ye shes me dpung rab 'bar ba// 'jigs med srung ba'i go cha btsan par gyur// ces thun mtshams kyi lhar ldangs te chad mtha' bsal la srung ba'i rgyas gdab pa ni/ gnas lngar bya khyung gi phyag rgyas reg ste/ ha ya grī ba hrīḥgab/ ba mo dha ra hrīḥgab/ pad+ma dha ra hrīḥgab/ tsan dha rak+ṣa hrīḥgab/ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ dgu pa smon lam gdab pa ni/ dge ba 'di yis 'gro kun sems can rnams// pad+ma rgyal po'i go 'phang mchog thob nas// ma rig ldongs pa'i skye tshogs thams cad la// rol pa'i rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog par shog / bcu pa shis brjod bya ba ni/ dkyil 'khor khyab bdag pad+ma kun tu 'chang*// rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bkra shis shog /'khor 'das dbang sgyur bde chen ye shes sku/ khrag 'thung rta mchog rgyal po'i bkra shis shog /chos kun 'byung gnas shes rab stong pa'i dbyings// yum mchog pad+ma gar dbang bkra shis shog /nyon mongs bzhi 'joms ye shes bzhi yi dngos/ khro rgyal dbang chen rigs bzhi'i bkra shis shog /tshad med bzhi ldan phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub// sgo srung khro mo bzhi yi bkra shis shog /ye shes rnam rol mi bsrun bdud dgra'i gshed// bka' dang bstan skyong tshogs kyi bkra shis shog
